blurb: Riverwood Campground is two miles east of Glenwood, Alberta along the Belly River. Established on 120 acres, our large area has allowed us to create an environment where families could enjoy spacious campsites, trees, natural grass, and wildlife while still providing open meadows and lots of room to play and explore.
